plan_a_advantages: Includes a dedicated hill session for climbing strength.
Incorporates a threshold run to improve running economy.
Features a longer, controlled run to build endurance.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster, primarily because it incorporates targeted hill work and a dedicated threshold session, both crucial for improving trail running power and efficiency. Plan B focuses almost exclusively on easy aerobic runs, which, while beneficial for building a base, won't directly address the specific demands of trail running like climbing and maintaining pace on varied terrain. Plan A’s inclusion of a longer, controlled run also better simulates the endurance required for longer trail races. While Plan B offers a slightly longer total duration, Plan A’s structured approach to building strength and speed is more appropriate for a runner with the stated goal.
